cd /workspace && echo "=== MainPage Inertia props: keys present ==="; python3 -c "
import re,html,json
h=open('/tmp/page.html',encoding='utf-8').read()
m=re.search(r'data-page=\"([^\"]+)\"',h)
d=json.loads(html.unescape(m.group(1)))
print('component:',d['component'])
print('props keys:',list(d['props'].keys()))
for k in d['props']:
    v=d['props'][k]
    if isinstance(v,(list,dict)):
        print(f'  {k}: <{type(v).__name__} len={len(v)}>')
    else:
        print(f'  {k}: {str(v)[:60]}')
" 2>&1
